content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for DIAT Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Applicants must be Indian nationals. Selected candidates must stay in institute accommodation inside the DIAT campus, subject to availability. All qualifications must be from UGC/AICTE recognized universities or institutions. EWS certificate must be issued on or after 01-04-2026. Time taken to acquire the PhD is not counted as teaching/research experience. Desirable: Teaching, research, industrial or professional experience in a reputed organization. Published work: at least 2 papers in Scopus indexed journals, patents, books or technical reports (Assistant Professor posts). Ph.D. and post-doctoral experience in the relevant area (Professor of Practice). Experience in DRDO, defence PSUs, aerospace/defence industries or Armed Forces (Professor of Practice).

content_sections.heading: DIAT Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates are required to perform specific roles according to their departments and specializations: Post Code 01 (Professor - School of Quantum Technology): Expertise in developing methods and devices for high sensitivity quantum sensing of magnetic fields, rotation, and gravity; design and development of advanced experimental platforms for quantum optics and quantum technologies, and advanced training based on them; expertise in quantum sensing and metrology with atomic vapours and laser-cooled atoms; quantum sensing with non-invasive quantum measurements and weak measurements; experience in precision optical and interferometric measurements. Post Code 02 (Assistant Professor - Aerospace Engineering & Autonomous Systems): UAV Design / Aircraft Design / Missile Design : UAV/Drone Design and Development, Aircraft Conceptual and preliminary Design, Missile configuration and System Design, Multidisciplinary Design Optimization. Post Code 03 (Assistant Professor - Electronics Engineering): VLSI & Embedded System / Semiconductor IC Design/Hardware Security. Post Code 04 (Assistant Professor - Joint appointment, Electronics Engineering jointly with School of Defence Technology & Management): Communication (Digital / Wireless / Mobile / Satellite) Electronic Warfare/ Advanced Modulation and Coding. Post Code 05 (Assistant Professor - Joint appointment, School of Defence Technology & Management jointly with Aerospace Engineering & Autonomous Systems): Advanced UAV design & integration, counter UAV technologies, simulation & autonomous navigation, Proficiency in software-in-the-Loop and Hardware-in-the-Loop simulation, Autonomous flight control algorithms, Prognostics and Health management for UAVs. Post Code 06 (Professor of Practice - Aerospace Engineering and Autonomous Systems): Area of Specialization: Missile Guidance and Control, Aircraft Control and Control of Robotic Systems. Essential Expertise: Working and research experience in the areas of missile, aircraft and robotic control. Post Code 07 (Professor of Practice - Electronics Engineering): Area of Specialization: SONAR system design, Radar systems, SONAR / Radar signal processing, Underwater acoustic communication, Array signal processing, Communication systems, EMI/EMC, Hardware security & cryptology, VLSI & Embedded systems, Semiconductor IC design, Electronic warfare, Detection and estimation theory. Essential Expertise: Working, research and hands-on experience in any of the above areas.

content_sections.heading: How Will DIAT Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on academic score and qualifications Presentation on domain knowledge and research area (regular positions only) Interview The academic score (UGC Regulations 2018, Appendix II, Table 2) is used only to shortlist candidates for interview; selection is based only on interview performance. Shortlisted candidates for regular positions may make a presentation of about 30 minutes, one day before the interview. Original documents with one set of self-attested copies must be produced at the interview.
